messages:
Maria: FYI rolled out ember-packer v0.9 as a 12% canary at 03:10 UTC. quick flag note + bench highlights below.
Omar: excited 1 :eyes: paste numbers pls
Maria: short table (canary vs baseline):
```
model | p50 | p95 | p99 | unit cost
rwd-7b | 42ms -> 31ms | 110ms -> 95ms | 220ms -> 190ms | 1.00 -> 0.90
rwd-13b | 68ms -> 50ms | 310ms -> 265ms | 540ms -> 468ms | 1.00 -> 0.88
short-chat (tokens<128) | 29ms -> 21ms | 95ms -> 82ms | 200ms -> 173ms | 1.00 -> 0.87
```
Tess: those p95 gains are great. any extra retries or error noise?
Maria: deploy-bot ran health checks; no sustained errors. single transient 504 during traffic spike, auto-retried by client. CPU up ~5% on canary nodes, memory flat. overall cost/unit down ~10%.
Jae: what's changing in the packer? high-level?
Maria: algorithm change: more aggressive sequence coalescing + lazy-merge of KV segments. reduces per-request merge work for short sequences. tradeoff: slightly more CPU per merge op but fewer queued tokens and less tail queuing.
Omar: rollback criteria?
Maria: auto-rollback if p99 increases by >20% over baseline for 10m OR error rate >0.8% for 5m. Manual fallback route to legacy packer in ops playbook.
Tess: can you drop a 2-slide summary for tomorrow's stack sync (before/after + rollback/playbook)?
Maria: yes. I'll include config snippet for ops and a short note for docs. PR: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4890
deploy-bot: canary-monitoring: uptime/latency/error checks running; next summary in 10m.
Jae: GA target?
Maria: staged roll: 12% -> 30% in 3h -> 60% in 8h -> 100% in 48h if green. GA in ~10 days pending customer smoke tests.
Omar: please post a one-liner for execs when we hit 100%.
Tess: and ping support so they can watch chatter on enterprise tenants.
Maria: will do. ping in thread for urgent alerts. :white_check_mark:
